senses.gloss:
रुणस्करा रुणस्करा, f. a cow easily milked,
a gentle cow.

रुणा रुणा, f., N. of a river flowing into
the Sarasvatī.

रुण्ट् रुण्ट्, cl. 1. P. रुण्टति, &c., to steal,
rob.

रुण्ठ् रुण्ठ् (= rt. लुण्ठ्), cl. 1. P. रुण्-
ठति, &c., to go; to be lame; to be
[]
idle; to strike against, resist; to steal, (in this sense
a various reading for rt. रुण्ट्.)

रुण्ड् रुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. रुण्डति, &c. = rt.
रुण्ट्, p. 848, col. 3.

रुण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, maimed, mutilated; (अस्), m.
according to some also (अम्), n. a headless body,
mere trunk (retaining life and continuing to mix in
battle).

रुण्डिका, f. a field of battle; a female messenger
or go-between; the threshold of a door; superhuman
power (= वि-भूति).
